title: Understanding LASSO Regression
text: LASSO regression is a type of linear regression that includes a penalty term to prevent overfitting. This penalty term is controlled by the parameter lambda. What effect does increasing lambda have on the model?

title: Training vs. Validation Error
text: If the training error is low but the validation error is high, this might indicate overfitting. Overfitting occurs when the model learns the training data too well, including its noise, and performs poorly on new data.
